angle_hi: एक अक्षर ब्रह्म के रूप में ॐ

en.intro: Listen for the sound that Krishna says is the one-syllable form of the absolute, and how it is joined to his own name at the final moment.
en.notice: The single syllable Om is called Brahman, the one-syllable absolute. It is not a mere sound, but the ultimate reality, and it is to be spoken while Krishna is remembered.
en.next: Krishna then tells Arjuna that for one who constantly remembers him, he is easy to reach.
en.meaning: Uttering Om, the one-syllable Brahman, and remembering Me, one who departs while leaving the body attains the supreme state.

hi.intro: उस एक अक्षर की ध्वनि को सुनिए जिसे कृष्ण परम सत्य कहते हैं, और जो अंतिम क्षण में उनके स्मरण से जुड़ा है।
hi.meaning: ॐ इति एकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन् माम् अनुस्मरन् यः प्रयाति त्यजन् देहं स याति परमां गतिम्
hi.next: कृष्ण फिर अर्जुन से कहते हैं कि जो निरंतर उनका स्मरण करता है, उनके लिए उनके पास पहुँचना सरल है।

The single syllable Om is called Brahman, the one-syllable absolute. It is not a mere sound, but the ultimate reality, and it is to be spoken while Krishna is remembered. Krishna then tells Arjuna that for one who constantly remembers him, he is easy to reach.
